page_title: LIV 2-2 MNU | Liverpool v Manchester Utd 05/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+7' Good chance! Joshua Zirkzee laid the ball off to Harry Maguire (Manchester United) inside the box, he ducked inside his man and rifled a shot in at goal that skimmed the top of the bar.
90+7' The free kick is taken by Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United), but ball is cleared.
90+6' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) is penalised for holding. Michael Oliver signals a set piece. Manchester Utd have a free kick.
90+5' Diogo Jota (Liverpool) hammers the ball from far out, but his shot is blocked by an opposition player.
90+4' The corner from Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) is cleared away by the defence.
90+4' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) inside the box. The referee signals a corner kick to Liverpool.
90+4' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) finds himself beyond the last defender but the linesman raises his flag for offside.
90+1' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked.
90' The fourth official shows 7 min. of added time.
90' Virgil van Dijk (Liverpool) wins himself just enough space inside the box to connect with the corner. His low header flies toward the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper blocks the effort.

90' What a wasted opportunity by Diogo Jota (Liverpool)! He creates himself some space inside the penalty box and unleashes a decent strike towards the top of the net, but Andre Onana makes an astonishing save to thwart him. Conor Bradley (Liverpool) collects a rebound and his promising attempt heads towards the right side of the goal, but Andre Onana keeps it out with an amazing save.
90' Amad Diallo (Manchester United) gets to the ball from the resulting corner and tries his luck with a shot, but one of the defenders steps in to block the effort.
90' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) will take a corner kick.

89' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) meets a delivery on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards to the bottom left corner. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Alisson pulls off an easy save. The referee points to the corner flag and Manchester Utd will take a corner.
89' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
89' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Manchester Utd win a corner.
86' That's the end of the game for Rasmus Hojlund, who is replaced by Joshua Zirkzee (Manchester United).
86' Here's the change. Trent Alexander-Arnold leaves the pitch and Conor Bradley (Liverpool) comes on as a substitute.
86' Arne Slot has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Harvey Elliott (Liverpool) replacing Cody Gakpo.

84' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Liverpool.
83' Substitution. Matthijs de Ligt will be replaced by Leny Yoro (Manchester United).
83' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
83' Alisson leaps to collect the ball from the corner which was sent over by Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United).

82' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety. Manchester Utd will take a corner kick.
80' 2 - 2 Goal! Alejandro Garnacho plays a pass to the feet of Amad Diallo (Manchester United), and he shoots into the bottom right corner from inside the box. It's 2:2.
79' Noussair Mazraoui (Manchester United) tries to find Alejandro Garnacho, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
78' Rasmus Hojlund (Manchester United) is in a clear offside position and the referee blows his whistle after the linesman raises his flag.
77' Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) is given a fully deserved yellow card. Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) will miss the next game.
75' The free kick from the edge of the box is taken by Mohamed Salah (Liverpool), who fires in a direct effort inches over the crossbar. What a chance!
74' Liverpool are about to take a free kick from a very dangerous position.
73' Harry Maguire (Manchester United) receives a harsh yellow card from the referee after committing a minor foul on his opponent.
72' The manager makes a subsitution with Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) coming on for Kobbie Mainoo.
70' 2 - 1 Goal! Andre Onana gets a hand on the penalty from Mohamed Salah (Liverpool), but can't stop it from flying inside the right post.
69' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
68' It’s a PENALTY to Liverpool after the VAR review!

68' Play continues despite the shouts by some Liverpool players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Michael Oliver interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
67' That looked a certain handball by Matthijs de Ligt (Manchester United) inside the box, but the ref wasn't having it and just played on. NO penalty!
66' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) receives the ball from Ryan Gravenberch and tries to beat the keeper from long range, but the effort goes high over the bar.
65' The resulting corner from Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) is cleared by the defence.
64' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. Liverpool force a corner. They send men into the box.
64' The referee is firm and issues Matthijs de Ligt (Manchester United) a deserved yellow card.
63' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) works the corner short.

63' A lofted cross from Noussair Mazraoui (Manchester United) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. The ball goes out of play and Manchester Utd have been awarded a corner kick.
62' The corner from Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) is intercepted by Alisson.
62' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Diogo Dalot (Manchester United). It will be a corner kick for Manchester Utd.
61' Arne Slot decides to make a substitution. Curtis Jones will be replaced by Diogo Jota (Liverpool).
60' Luis Diaz comes off the pitch to be replaced by Darwin Nunez (Liverpool).
60' The goal stands! That took a long time for referee Michael Oliver to decide it wasn’t offside. The relieved Liverpool players can finally celebrate.
60' Wait! Referee Michael Oliver has indicated he is going to review the Liverpool goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
59' 1 - 1 That was a nice piece of skill by Cody Gakpo (Liverpool)! He skips past a few defenders and manages to fire a superb effort that goes into the top right corner. The score is 1:1.
56' The goalkeeper punched the ball away after Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) took the corner.

56' Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger. Alisson makes a sensational save to thwart a great chance. A rebound falls to Kobbie Mainoo (Manchester United) inside the box and he strikes goalwards, but the ball ends up in the keeper's gloves instead of the bottom left corner.
56' Ryan Gravenberch (Liverpool) tackles a bit over-zealously and Michael Oliver blows for a foul.
53' Amad Diallo (Manchester United) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Michael Oliver had an easy-decision to make.
52' 0 - 1 Bruno Fernandes plays a neat ball into the path of Lisandro Martinez (Manchester United), who makes room for a shot and fires in off the crossbar! 0:1.
50' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) swings in the corner, but the goalkeeper does a brilliant job to intercept the effort.
49' Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) has a shot blocked from inside the box. Corner kick. Manchester Utd will have an opportunity.
48' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) is penalised for a foul. Michael Oliver had a clear view and blows his whistle.
48' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) attempts to find a teammate with the corner, but the effort is snuffed out by the goalkeeper.

47' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Liverpool.
46' The second half has just started.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.

45+1' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. Ryan Gravenberch (Liverpool) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
45' It looks like Kobbie Mainoo (Manchester United) saw red with that tackle. Michael Oliver won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.

42' Rasmus Hojlund (Manchester United) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and releases it towards the right post. Unfortunately for him, Alisson makes a great save to stop his effort. Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
41' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out.
40' Foul! Lisandro Martinez (Manchester United) is penalised for pulling back his opponent.
38' Matthijs de Ligt (Manchester United) was standing in a clear offside position, making it an easy call for the linesman.
37' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) sends a cross in and finds Alexis Mac Allister inside the box, but one of the defenders steps in and clears the danger.
36' Manuel Ugarte (Manchester United) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Michael Oliver blows his whistle for an infringement.
35' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
32' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) but poses no threat. The ball goes out of play and Manchester Utd will have a goal kick.
31' Kobbie Mainoo (Manchester United) sends a cross into the box, but Alisson comes off his line to gather the ball.
30' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) commits a foul and Michael Oliver immediately signals a free kick.
29' It looked like the long-range shot by Ryan Gravenberch (Liverpool) would end up in the net, but the effort went painfully wide of the left post. The goalkeeper was quite lucky this time.
28' 4:2 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams. The current number of shots on goal is 1:0.
24' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.

24' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) attempted to send a defence-splitting pass into space where Rasmus Hojlund was lurking. It could have put him one-on-one with the goalkeeper, but one of the defending players somehow manages to avert the threat.
23' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) was quite harsh and Michael Oliver didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
22' Harry Maguire (Manchester United) finds himself in an offside position and the referee stops play after the linesman raises his flag.
22' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
21' The game is interrupted now, Amad Diallo (Manchester United) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.

20' This shall not pass! Noussair Mazraoui (Manchester United) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender. Kobbie Mainoo (Manchester United) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.

19' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play. The ball is behind the touchline and Liverpool will take a throw-in.
16' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) sends in the corner, but the keeper steps in and makes a save.

16' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) picks up a lofted cross inside the box and releases a quick shot to the bottom right corner. His promising effort is kept out by Andre Onana, who pulls off a stunning save! Liverpool have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
14' CHANCE! Ryan Gravenberch finds Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) with a sweet pass, but he can't find the target as his effort from inside the box goes just wide of the right post!

13' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal. Luis Diaz (Liverpool) runs onto a good long pass and tries his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort flies high over the bar.

12' Manuel Ugarte (Manchester United) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee. Liverpool win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
11' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Manchester Utd.
8' Harry Maguire (Manchester United) sends a long ball forward to Bruno Fernandes, but he put too much power and the chance is gone. The linesman signals a throw-in for Liverpool.
7' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) sends the corner into the box, but Andre Onana intercepts it and averts the threat.
6' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
5' Liverpool are seeing far more of the ball now.
4' Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
3' Kobbie Mainoo (Manchester United) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
2' Kobbie Mainoo (Manchester United) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
1' Poor challenge! Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) is penalised for tripping and Michael Oliver blows his whistle.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Liverpool will kick the game off.
Michael Oliver is the one to supervise the game today.
